label_status: Frozen AI v3 primary/direct anchors; original and all-public sensitivity. Not independently human validated.
working_tree: dirty development experiment; exact runtime hashes bound in protocol

protocol.authorization: User requested continuing to a fixed-label configuration comparison. This authorizes development experiments, not closing Q1/Q2 gates or changing defaults.
protocol.gate_status: Q1 review/commit/CI and independent Q2 validation remain pending. Dirty working-tree exploratory run only. No official benchmark or production promotion.

prerequisite_findings.Q1: Frozen stage traces and token diagnostics prepared; some relevant evidence is present but lost before/following ranking.
prerequisite_findings.Q2: v3 expands public evidence anchors and distinguishes primary/corroboration. AI-assisted summary review only; same v3 hashes used across all treatments.

protocol.missing_section_path: Use body unchanged when section_path is empty.

fixed.queries: 32 real answerable dev queries from frozen Q2 inventory
fixed.boundaries: identical stored chunk IDs, body text, spans, section paths, document versions, ACL metadata
fixed.bm25: Frozen ordered baseline BM25 top50 for the identical raw query and tenant/permission scope; every reuse reauthorized in SQL. Underlying raw treatment index outputs are not used.
fixed.dense: existing exact SQL retriever; same frozen query embeddings
fixed.fusion: RRF k=60, BM25 top50, dense top50, fused top20
fixed.rerank: same pinned MiniLM, same tokenizer/truncation settings, retain all20; no expansion or parent expansion
fixed.labels: original anchors and frozen v3 primary/direct-source groups, secondary sensitivity separate
fixed.query_document_prefixes: Existing embedder service owns search_query/search_document prefixes.

primary_tests.embedding: B versus A hybrid candidate anchor Recall@20, paired per-query bootstrap; primary v3 labels, original-label sensitivity reported.
primary_tests.reranker: C versus A MRR on the identical frozen A top20 candidate lists. D versus B is a secondary confirmation on frozen B lists.

secondary_metrics: truncation counts and actual tokenizer visibility
protocol.decision_rule: No default promotion in this task. A result supports further review only if its predeclared primary paired-bootstrap lower bound exceeds zero, SQL ACL checks pass and reranker-only candidate/Recall20 parity holds. Otherwise report no clear difference.

statistics.interval: 95% percentile paired bootstrap over all32 query IDs
statistics.multiplicity: two predeclared primary hypotheses; intervals are unadjusted exploratory intervals, not confirmatory evidence

protocol.isolation: Unique throwaway body and section database copies; no re-chunking; only clone chunk embeddings may be updated; drop only those generated copies after outputs are saved. Main fingerprint must remain identical.
protocol.control_amendment: Raw BM25 order drifted after embedding-only row updates in the clone. For the valid run, freeze baseline SQL-ACL-filtered BM25 top50 rankings and supply exactly those rankings to both arms through a context-receiving retriever that revalidates all IDs in SQL; do not filter them in Python. Raw treatment BM25 is an unused diagnostic. This control fix follows a failed invariance check, without inspecting treatment quality scores.
